# 0002: land direct to main

Work lands directly on `main`, one commit at a time, with `.land/land-direct` (a stub for the pinned vbm-land in `.land/tool/`: never edit it; `.land/tool/bin/land-update <tag>` updates it). It rebases onto fresh `origin/main`, runs Tier 1 (`mise exec -- scripts/tier1.sh`) on exactly that result, and pushes a plain fast-forward. `.land/land.conf` holds the base, the Tier 1 command and the step timeout; nothing else refuses a landing (the approvals, the protected set, the size budget, the gate-diff judge and the relabel-attack suite were removed on 2026-11-06; `git log` has the commit). Red = the `tier1` job of the latest push run of `core.yml`; while main is red only a fix or a revert lands. After a landing the worker's branch still holds its pre-rebase commits: start the next task from a fresh worktree off `origin/main`. Tier 2 runs on main after the push.
